comparisons.peer_topic: Revenue recognition for support and professional services
comparisons.peer_summary: Support services revenue is recognized ratably over the term as they represent stand-ready obligations. Professional services revenue is recognized over time as the customer simultaneously receives and consumes the benefits.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AVGO disclose revenue recognition policies for support services. NVDA identifies deferred revenue primarily including deferrals related to support for hardware and software, while AVGO explicitly states that support services (consisting of telephone support and updates) represent stand-ready obligations for which revenue is recognized ratably over the term.
